flows.title: Schedule a meeting
steps: Sign in to the Zoom web portal. In the top-right corner, click the Zoom Products icon, then click Meetings. Meetings opens in a new browser tab.
Enter a topic or name for the meeting, and set the date and time.
Optionally add invitees by their name, email or phone number, and select the meeting options.
Click Save. When the host has the calendar and contacts integration on, invitees get an email invitation once the meeting is saved.

flows.title: Join a meeting from a browser
steps: Go to join.zoom.us, enter the meeting ID the host or organizer gave you, and click Join.

With an invitation link instead, click the join link in the email or calendar invitation. When a pop-up asks to open or download the app, click Cancel, then click join from your browser at the bottom of the page. The host has to have that link turned on.
Click Allow to give Zoom the microphone and camera, enter your name, and click Join. The host may admit you from a waiting room.

flows.title: Find a cloud recording
steps: Sign in to the Zoom web portal and click Recordings & Transcripts in the navigation menu.
Click the Cloud recordings tab. It lists the cloud recordings you started that have finished processing.
Adjust the date range and status, then search by host, meeting ID, topic or keyword.
A recording that is not there may be in the trash folder, where a cloud recording can be recovered within 30 days.
